purpose.zh: 拉伸前腿的臀部和后腿的髋前侧
purpose.en: Stretch the glute of your front leg and the front of your back hip.

text.zh: 前腿小腿横在身前，后腿往后伸直
text.en: Bring your front shin across and stretch the back leg behind you

text.zh: 双手扶砖，骨盆尽量摆正，别硬往下压。
text.en: Hands on the blocks, hips as square as you can, do not force them down.

text.zh: 保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
text.en: Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.

text.zh: 别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。
text.en: Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

commonErrors.en: Letting your hips tilt to one side.

cautions.zh: 膝盖疼时垫高臀部，或换成仰卧4字拉伸
cautions.en: If your knee hurts, prop your hips higher or switch to the lying figure-4 stretch.

changes: 剂量 → 每侧 2 组×4 次（rep_hold，stretchLoop）
EN 名 Pigeon Pose → Pigeon Stretch（与其余拉伸统一）
primary 缩短为一个指令（扶砖移到 cue2）
按用户决定改为静态保持计时，动画只作示意
剂量 → 每侧 2 组×45 秒，休息 15 秒；口令/要点改为进入-保持-呼气放松，去掉来回/计数描述
